plans.note: Section 9 is the express limitation of liability; check mutuality, cap size (likely tied to fees paid) and carve-outs, and read together with the indemnity (sec-8-2) and warranty disclaimer (sec-8) for any liability exclusions.

Section 8 (INDEMNIFICATION) should carry Commerce One's IP infringement indemnity in our favour as licensee/host; confirm it is not narrowed by the liability cap in sec-9 and that any Corio-side indemnity is limited to our own misuse.

Grant of Rights (sec-3) with TERRITORY and CORIO MARKET SEGMENT definitions is the likely home of any restriction on the products we may host or the segments we may serve; also scan Shared Resources and the sales/marketing cooperation exhibit.

Check the licence grant and the CORIO MARKET SEGMENT / ASP definitions for any obligation to host only Commerce One software, plus the marketing cooperation exhibit for de facto exclusive-promotion commitments.
Review the Fees section and Exhibit B pricing/revenue-sharing terms for any most-favoured-pricing undertaking; only flag if the obligation runs from us to Commerce One.
No dedicated non-solicit heading; most likely place would be Miscellaneous or the confidentiality/shared-resources provisions. Confirm absent before recording as missing.
Section 11 (Term and Termination) — check whether we may terminate for convenience on notice without penalty and whether Commerce One has any symmetric or unilateral mid-term exit.
Renewal term, notice window and any renewal price uplift will sit in Section 11, with pricing mechanics possibly cross-referenced to Exhibit B.
Miscellaneous should contain governing law and forum; the defined term RULES suggests an arbitration reference — check whether disputes go to arbitration and where.
Assignment/change-of-control clause expected in Miscellaneous; check whether a change of control of Corio gives Commerce One a termination right (cross-check sec-11).

Ownership provisions likely in Grant of Rights and the DEVELOPMENTS definition; confirm we retain our own data, configurations and any Corio-created developments, and review trademark and escrow sections for related IP allocations.

Section 2 Grant of Rights plus the SOFTWARE, DEMONSTRATION SOFTWARE, TERRITORY and CUSTOMER(S) definitions and Exhibit A; confirm scope reaches our customers/affiliates/contractors and that the licence is not revocable at will.
Any audit of our revenue reports and Software User counts will sit with Fees or the Exhibit B payment terms; test frequency, notice, location and who bears cost.
Look for late-payment penalties or fixed damages in Fees/Payment Terms; service credits running to us are acceptable and should not be flagged.

Section 7 Warranties and Disclaimer is primary; check the Warranty Period and Acceptance Test terms in Delivery (sec-3-2) and the support/maintenance obligations and Exhibit C service outline for the remedy.
No insurance heading in the outline; check Miscellaneous and the indemnity section before recording as missing.
Exhibit B pricing and revenue-sharing fees plus Section 4 are where any minimum guaranteed fees or committed volumes would appear; confirm any commitment has an exit.

Effects-of-termination language in Section 11 plus the Source Code Escrow section (sec-12) are the likely sources of continuity/wind-down rights; check for return of data and post-termination support for existing customers.
